name: Magazino TORU
summary: A mobile picking robot with a vacuum gripper on a lifting column that takes single boxes up to 5.8 kg from shelves 8 to 250 cm high and carries up to 16 of them to a hand-over point.

germany.statusNote: Made and sold in Germany by Magazino GmbH (Munich), a Jungheinrich company; project sale on request. NEOintralogistics offers TORU in its storage system on a pay-per-pick basis. No public price.
germany.leadTime: NEOintralogistics system: 6 to 8 weeks to operation

sellers.name: Magazino GmbH
sellers.note: Landsberger Str. 234, 80687 München; contact form on the product page.

sellers.name: NEOintralogistics GmbH
sellers.note: Supplies a complete system (containers, TORU robots, buffer station, software); payment per pick.

specs.conditions: single box or KLT; NEO system article states 5 kg per container

specs.conditions: above floor; NEO system article states up to 220 cm

specs.value: Vacuum gripper moving in a lifting column; can lift stacks

specs.label: Fleet software

notes: Handles shoe boxes and standard small containers (NEO-KLT) in shelving, not loose or irregular items.
Hands over to conveyors, flow racks, pick carts or put walls.
Operating time up to 20 h per day; battery runtime per charge is not published.
